description: Start a casting: real creators film the app and post it on their own accounts. With dry_run: true nothing is saved and nobody is contacted; you get who SeedViews will look for, the brief, the opening message (opening_message_preview), the price, the totals and the timeline to show your person. Without dry_run a draft is created and the answer holds pay_url (with an API key, a page that takes the payment with no sign-in): your person must open it to pay before any creator hears about it (creator pay plus 5% is collected up front, anything unused is refunded automatically). Plans: $99 a month up to 30 videos live, $249 up to 100, starting when the first video is live. Before your person pays, tell them what the card is charged later, not only now. Creator pay plus 5% when they pay. The card is kept for the plan: $99 a month, first charged when a video passes the check, then every month until they cancel it in the dashboard. In a month with more than 30 videos live, the plan moves to Growth ($249) and the $150 difference is charged that day. A cancelled plan starts again, and is charged, when a video from a casting still running passes the check. plan.charges in the answer says the same. Without an API key the answer includes casting_token: keep it and pass it to every other tool; it is shown once.

brief.description: What the video should show and say. Leave it out to get a draft written from the store listing.

deadline_days.description: Days a creator has from their yes to their last post (default 14).

dry_run.description: true: save nothing, contact nobody, charge nothing; only show what this casting would cost and do.

looking_for.description: Who to look for. Leave it out to use what SeedViews drafts from the store link.

countries.description: Where the creators should live. Leave it out to use the countries drafted from the store listing; an empty list [] means anywhere. Not a hard filter: each creator's country is shown.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the creators post in, which is their audience's language, e.g. 'en'. For a language app this is the language the learners already speak ('en'), not the one they learn.

niche.description: The creators' niche, e.g. 'habit tracking, productivity'. For a language app, the languages learned go here, e.g. 'learning Japanese, manga'.

notify_url.description: Optional https address that gets a signed POST when a person has something to do or something changed (a video or payout awaiting approval with its deadline, a creator signed, the casting paid, opened or closed). If an approval is still waiting about 12 hours before its deadline, video.approval_reminder includes video_id and deadline (and payout_id when waiting on payment). The answer holds notify_secret once: keep it to check each delivery's seedviews-signature header.

opening_message.description: The template of SeedViews' first message to each creator; leave it out to use the one drafted from the app and brief (opening_message in the answer). It must start with "Hi [name], [a line about one of their videos]. ", which SeedViews writes per creator, as it does any other [field] you add. Write [pay] where the pay goes: it is filled from the casting (opening_message_preview shows it). No other amount, no link, at most 700 characters, ending with one easy question.

price_usd.description: What each creator is paid per video, in US dollars (default 25). One price for everyone; creators take it or pass. A higher price gets more yeses.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link. Ask your person if you do not know it.
